name: vision_video3d
title: A video classifier over sampled clips: random clip offset while training, centre clip while evaluating, written correctly
origin: domain-vision round 1: the R(2+1)D / temporal-loader shape - a clip Dataset with per-split sampling policy and a 3D convolutional stack

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the evaluation loaders are built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_clip_transform() is Resize + CenterCrop + Normalize, and the evaluation datasets are constructed with train=False
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward()
the order is backward -> clip -> step
the only no_grad region is the decorated evaluate(), which contains no backward()
the running loss accumulates loss.item()
MultiStepLR is an epoch schedule and scheduler.step() is called once per epoch
clip_grad_norm_ sits between backward() and step()
evaluate() calls model.eval() first and restores model.train()
evaluate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
VideoNet.forward returns the linear head's output - logits - and the criterion is CrossEntropyLoss
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the clips and the labels are moved to the model's device in both loops
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
the three splits are three directories
SpatioTemporalBlock and VideoNet both call super().__init__()
the stage list is an nn.ModuleList
torch.save writes the state_dict() and torch.load passes map_location= and weights_only=True
